 Canary Call Watchalong - Norwich City v Watford (31/10/26)
 Close Canary Call Watchalong - Norwich City v Watford (31/10/26)
 Watch live here from 14:30 Summary
 Norwich City are losing 2-0 to Watford at Carrow Road
 Last week the Canaries won their first Championship match in six with a 3-1 victory at Charlton 
 Rob Butler and Cedric Anselin take your calls and views on Canary Call following the match
 Subscribe to the BBC Sounds Norwich City page here 
 Live Reporting
 Most recent Most popular Canary Call Watchalong published at 13:05 GMT 13:05 GMT 
 BBC Radio Norfolk's Rob Butler and former City midfielder Cedric Anselin host Canary Call following the Canaries' Championship game against Watford.
 We'll be taking your calls after the final whistle on 0800 389 7 321.
 Join in on social media by using #canarycall.
 You can watch along with us above when the show starts.
